readerContract.humanQuestion: Does Z.AI’s financing announcement mean AI can already train and improve itself?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Separate proposed money, intended research and demonstrated capability; know what evidence a future self-improvement claim needs.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No capital-markets or model-training vocabulary assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Financing a technical vision establishes intention to invest, not success at the technical goal.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A colleague shares a headline saying AI can improve itself and worries their everyday chatbot is now changing on its own.
readerContract.surfaceJob: Dated September13 issuer announcement interpreted on September15 for AI beginners.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can tell what has been proposed, what is still being researched and what actually changed.

draftArchitecture.openingJob: September13 conditional financing announcement, approximate5b context, intended60%use.
causalSequence: New shares and bonds are proposed financing transactions with completion conditions.
Intended60% supports next-generation GLM, self-training research and computing infrastructure.
Technical vision uses earlier models to help build later models’ training resources; manual spot-checking remains.
An investment plan does not prove that loop works or establish a current chatbot change.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A colleague forwards an AI-improves-itself headline; ask whether it reports financing, a research plan or a measured capability.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A later company announcement still needs a named system, measured change and evidence showing limits.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Ask what was tested, which model changed and how the improvement was checked.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No runaway-machine fiction, investor advice, GLM6 name or completed5b claim.

humourPlan.noneReason: The actual status distinction supplies reader value.

draftArchitecture.presentationPlan: People-free blank research notebook and generic computing tower, no completed results or finance symbols; exact companion admission required.
draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Z.AI proposes funding for a technical vision, not proof AI already trains itself successfully.
